description:
A regex literal inside an `` slot is pattern text: a quote or a brace inside it neither opens a string nor counts toward the slot's extent, so the slot compiles exactly as the same `${…}` does in a `

`.
provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S462 `<md>` F1 "a" (`${…}` inside `<md>` is TEXT-ONLY) · review:s465-md finding 2
rationale: §67.2: the splitter takes the §4.18.1b token-depth extent, found by lexing the interpolation body. A `/` that the logic tokenizer reads as a regex literal opens one token running to its closing `/` and flags, so `'` and `{` `}` inside it are not string or brace tokens; the slot closes at the `}` that balances its `${`.
